_comment: Who receives calls, WhatsApp messages and form leads. Leads never go to the site owner: each area points to its own workshop entry, and pages without an area use 'default'. While an entry's tenant_status is 'unassigned', its page hides the call, WhatsApp and form buttons and shows a 'coming soon' note. Set tenant_status to 'trial' or 'tenant' only once a real workshop has agreed; the build refuses to show an entry that still has TODO or all-zero values. Every change here goes through a pull request that Muhammad merges.
_fields: workshop_id: stable short slug (lowercase, digits, dashes), sent with analytics events; never change it once live. workshop.name: shown on the page. workshop.area: the area named in 'Your enquiry goes to ...'. workshop.coverage: list of neighbourhoods it covers (optional). phone: E.164, e.g. +60123456789. whatsapp: digits only, for wa.me. web3forms_key: that workshop's own Web3Forms access key (public by design; it only says which inbox gets the email). tenant_status: unassigned | trial | tenant. Never add a logo or photo for a trial workshop; a logo is only shown for a tenant.
